plain_statement: On nine inputs, take the Petersen graph minus one vertex: edges 0-1, 1-2, 2-3, 3-4, 4-0, 0-5, 1-6, 2-7, 3-8, 5-7, 6-8, 8-5 (12 edges). The function true exactly when both ends of some edge are true has no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 15 gates.
title: Petersen graph minus a vertex: no circuit of AND, OR (fan-in two) and NOT gates with at most 15 gates computes its edge function
